description: For a manufacturer's agent (needs the supplier token): change processes, materials, certs, formats, industries, signals, machines, lead_time_days, min_order_qty, notes or notify_email. Fields you leave out keep their value; a field you send replaces it whole (a processes list replaces the stored list, so send the complete list, not only additions). Name, domain, country and address cannot be changed here. Set authorised: true only after the manufacturer confirmed the change.

supplier_token.description: Only if your client cannot send the Authorization: Bearer header
